Name: Marksman
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: Marksmen are proficient in the use of firearms. They are hired often as bodyguards, assassins, or lookouts. They are more expensive than regular mercenaries due to their upkeep, but their inclusion in a mercenary band or among a group of raiders grants them a unique edge.

traits.name: Point-Blank Accuracy
traits.description: The marksman does not suffer disadvantage on attack rolls using firearms caused by hostile creatures being within 5 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The marksman makes two attacks with its Shortsword or Revolver.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Revolver
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rifle
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Sniper’s Breath (3/Day)
bonus_actions.description: When making an attack with a firearm at long range, the marksman does not suffer from disadvantage, and instead rolls 1d6 and adds it to the attack roll.
